provider.title: Configure Frigate Vision
provider.description: Provider credentials and URLs are stored only in this integration.

data_description.endpoint: Base URL ending in /v1, or a complete /chat/completions URL.
data_description.timeout: Maximum provider request duration for still-image analysis.
data_description.video_timeout: Maximum provider request duration for video-frame analysis.
data_description.target_width: Maximum still-image width. Smaller images are never enlarged.
data_description.event_image_source: Prefer a frame from the recording/main stream or always use Frigate's detect event snapshot.
data_description.recording_wait_timeout: How long to wait for recording frames before using the detect snapshot fallback.
data_description.go2rtc_url: Optional local/internal override. Leave empty for the Home Assistant proxy. External clients never reuse this URL.
data_description.go2rtc_url_external: Leave empty to use the Home Assistant proxy externally. External clients never fall back to the local go2rtc URL.
data_description.go2rtc_modes: Comma-separated: webrtc,mse,mp4,hls,mjpeg. WebRTC is tried first and MSE is the first fallback.
